description:
The drift-prevention claim (schema is single source of truth) is only covered transitively by the existing US-002 status/key tests. A tiny explicit guard test asserting OFFICIAL_DOCS_VALIDATED_STATUSES deep-equals ['aligned','corrected','no_external_lib_touched','fetch_failed] and the allowed-key set equals the 5 schema keys would make an accidental schema edit fail loudly at the unit level. Non-blocking: the PRD notes justify skipping it and behavior is already covered.
